verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax offers itemized exports with line-item tax breakdowns per transaction, which is a data-export capability, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive 'export all data' feature, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g., CSV/JSON specification), or support for fully leaving the platform with your data. missing for 10: full data export scope beyond tax reports, explicit open-format documentation, independent confirmation of unrestricted data portability.
